name: What are the main layout types for multigenerational homes?

mainEntity.name: What are the main layout types for multigenerational homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common layouts include in-law suites, attached ADUs, separate wings with private entrances, main-level guest quarters, or flexible bonus spaces that convert to independent living areas.
